_comment: Bundled SAMPLE ticket for offline demonstration. This is NOT a real Jira issue — it never mixes with fetched tickets and is always marked source=sample_fixture. Used to walk the gap-analysis -> plan -> gate -> cases flow without Jira credentials.
description_text:
As a user I want to log in to the VWO dashboard at app.vwo.com so that I can access my experiments.

Support email and password login plus Google SSO. Show a clear error message on invalid credentials. Remember me should persist the session across browser restarts for up to 30 days.

Support SSO for enterprise accounts and Passkey sign-in. The page must follow WCAG 2.1 AA and enforce HTTPS. Login success and failure events must be sent to analytics.
